free_tier.stated: No free tier. EPYC-01 is EUR 3.99 a month: 1 vCore AMD EPYC, 4GB RAM, 50GB NVMe, unmetered traffic at 300 Mbit/s, 1 IPv4 plus a routed IPv6 /64, in Eygelshoven, Netherlands. The vendor page reads: 1 IPv4 + IPv6 /64 Subnet, Unlimited traffic.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a virtual server, not an object store

retention.stated: not applicable: a live server, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Unmetered: the port speed, 300 Mbit/s on EPYC-01, is a hard rate limit, with no monthly volume allowance and no overage billing; the vendor FAQ adds that bandwidth may be temporarily throttled on disproportionately high sustained usage.

interface_detail: SSH on the guest; a public REST API of 48 endpoints, a web portal and a Discord bot manage power, backups and firewall rules.
tooling: ssh, the REST API and the per-server stateless firewall; any VPN or tunnel daemon the guest supports.
chaining: A dedicated IPv4 plus a routed IPv6 /64 for EUR 3.99 a month, with an Accept-by-default stateless firewall and upstream filtering of TCP and UDP: a UDP-capable endpoint with inbound ports and a routed prefix.

limits.value: 300 Mbit/s port speed, no volume cap

binding_note: There is no volume quota; 300 Mbit/s is the limit, and the FAQ allows a temporary throttle on sustained high use.

identity_cost.detail: A third-party post quoting the vendor says: No KYC, no ID document, no phone number, no verification call; the vendor privacy notice lists name, address, email address and phone number as examples of data collected when a contract is concluded. Checkout bills EU-27 customers only, so a US, UK, Swiss or Canadian buyer cannot complete an order.

reliability_note: Billing is limited to EU-27 customers; the vendor FAQ allows a temporary throttle on sustained high use, which the offer post states as no post-quota throttle.
confidence_note: The price, resources, IPv4 and /64 lines are vendor page lines read on 2026-11-03 and agree with the third-party post. The identity statement rests on that post quoting the vendor, so the rung for identity is reported.
